tickerText: [TENNIS] Alexandrova stuns world No. 1 Sabalenka 7-6, 4-6, 6-4 in Toronto as Shnaider also ousts Pegula; Shelton powers into Montreal's round of 16 • [SQUASH] PSA Valencia opens August 11 as London Classic Gold tickets sell ahead of September's Ally Pally return; Salman Khalil claimed his maiden World Events title in Karachi • [BADMINTON] Ashmita Chaliha wins maiden BWF World Tour title at Korea Masters, rallying past Han Qian Xi 14-21, 21-14, 21-14 in Asan • [PICKLEBALL] PPA Tour Europe launches with 20 events across nine countries for 2026–27; Veolia National Championships in Cary opens the global season August 31 • [TABLE TENNIS] Matsushima rallies from 4-8 down to beat Jang Woo-jin and reach Yokohama semis alongside Harimoto and Shinozuka on WTT Champions final day

newsItems.title: Alexandrova Upsets Sabalenka
newsItems.excerpt: Ekaterina Alexandrova knocked out world No. 1 Aryna Sabalenka 7-6, 4-6, 6-4 at the National Bank Open in Toronto to reach her first quarterfinal at the event.

newsItems.title: Chaliha Wins Korea Masters
newsItems.excerpt: Ashmita Chaliha captured her maiden BWF World Tour title, rallying past Han Qian Xi 14-21, 21-14, 21-14 in the Korea Masters Super 300 final in Asan.

newsItems.title: PPA Tour Europe Launches
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Tour debuts PPA Tour Europe — 20 professional events across nine countries with a €545,000 prize pool for the 2026–27 season.

newsItems.title: Matsushima Into Yokohama Semis
newsItems.excerpt: Sora Matsushima rallied from 4-8 down to beat Jang Woo-jin in Yokohama, joining Tomokazu Harimoto and Hiroto Shinozuka in the WTT Champions semifinals.
